```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "setup.R"))

child_files <- c(
  "01_exercise_5_7.Rmd",
  "02_exercise_5_8.Rmd",
  "03_exercise_5_11.Rmd",
  "04_laliga.Rmd"
)

render_child <- function(file) {
  path <- here::here("exercises", file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Không tìm thấy file: ", path)

  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  has_yaml <- length(lines) > 0 && trimws(lines[1]) == "---"
  title <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  if (has_yaml) {
    yaml_end <- which(trimws(lines) %in% c("---", "..."))
    yaml_end <- yaml_end[yaml_end > 1]

    if (length(yaml_end) > 0) {
      end <- yaml_end[1]
      metadata <- yaml::yaml.load(paste(lines[2:(end - 1)], collapse = "\n"))
      if (!is.null(metadata$title)) title <- as.character(metadata$title)[1]
      lines <- if (end < length(lines)) lines[-seq_len(end)] else character(0)
    }
  }

  # đổi tên chunk trong file con để tránh trùng với main và các file khác
prefix <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

lines <- vapply(lines, function(line) {
  if (grepl("^\\s*```\\{r(?:\\s|,|\\})", line)) {
    line <- sub(
      "^(\\s*```\\{r)\\s+([[:alnum:]_.-]+)",
      paste0("\\1 ", prefix, "-\\2"),
      line
    )
  }
  line
}, character(1))

content <- c(paste0("# ", title), "", lines)
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = content, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}
```
